content: Administer one applicator full (approximately 6 grams) intravaginally either once daily or every 12 hours for a duration of 30 days. The safety and efficacy of this treatment have not been fully established. Local sensitivity reactions, such as discomfort or burning, may occur. This medication is contraindicated in individuals with hypersensitivity to sulfonamides, during the third trimester of pregnancy, and in cases of severe blood reactions, including aplastic anemia, agranulocytosis, and other blood dyscrasias, which have been reported. Severe skin reactions, such as toxic epidermal necrolysis and Stevens-Johnson syndrome, have also been reported. Additionally, fulminant hepatic necrosis has been associated with sulfonamides, regardless of the route of administration. If a skin rash or reaction occurs, discontinue use immediately. This medication is classified as Pregnancy Category C, meaning that risk to the fetus cannot be ruled out. Its use during lactation is not recommended. The drug exerts a bacteriostatic effect by inhibiting para-aminobenzoic acid, thereby interfering with microbial folic acid synthesis and growth.
